messages:
Ava - Account Exec: Hey team — Acme legal asked for DR/BCP evidence as part of the vendor review. They specifically want measured RTO/RPO, backup cadence, failover steps, and any DR test results. Can we assemble a concise package by EOD Friday?
Ravi - Solutions Eng: Quick summary I can provide: Dedicated tier SLA is 99.95% with warm-standby multi-region failover. Typical RTO for model endpoints on Dedicated is ~5-15 minutes (DNS + routing) depending on model size and KV rehydration. RPO target for customer data is 1 hour for hosted backups; for Private we can do real-time replication.
Marta - InfoSec: Need documentary evidence, not just statements. They want: SOC2 report (latest), DR runbook excerpts, last DR test date + playbook runbook results, backup retention policy (snapshot & object), and architecture diagram showing cross-region replication. Also CAIQ/SIG pointer where controls map.
Jordan - Acme IT (customer): FYI — our procurement team needs explicit measured numbers from past tests, e.g., "last failover completed in X minutes" and any outstanding corrective actions. They also want assurance that backups are encrypted and KMS keys are customer-separable.
Ava - Account Exec: @Jordan noted. @Marta @Ravi — can we give them a short bundle: 1) one-pager with RTO/RPO numbers + how they're measured, 2) DR runbook excerpt (redacted), 3) last test summary, 4) SOC2 link, 5) CAIQ mapping?
Ravi - Solutions Eng: I'll draft the one-pager and include measured times from our last Dedicated failover test (internal): failover initiation -> traffic cutover = 2m 40s; KV cache warm = 6m 10s; total measured RTO = 8m 50s. Test date: 2026-01-14. I can also include the test harness logs snippet. Example snippet:
```
2026-01-14 14:02:03 trigger failover
2026-01-14 14:04:43 dns propagation 95% traffic
2026-01-14 14:11:13 kv-cache warmed 98% hit rate
```
Ravi - Solutions Eng: For backups: hosted: hourly snapshot to S3 with CRR to secondary region, daily full snapshot retention 30d, encrypted with AWS KMS (customer CMKs for Dedicated/Private). For Private we document customer-managed KMS integration.
Marta - InfoSec: Add that the snapshots are immutable for 14 days by default (retention+WORM options available). Also note our RPO SLA language is: hosted: best-effort hourly (operational RPO target 1h), Dedicated: configurable down to near-zero with streaming replication. Please don't promise more than our contracts.
Olive - Legal: I'll need the exact contractual SLA wording for uptime and remedies for breaches. Also need confirmation of data segregation in Dedicated and Private. Please include the SLA excerpt and the contract section reference.
Ava - Account Exec: Good call, @Olive. @Ravi can you paste the short SLA excerpt we can share with procurement? Keep redactions minimal.
Ravi - Solutions Eng: SLA excerpt (redacted): "Redwood Dedicated: 99.95% uptime measured monthly. Service credits tiered by monthly availability. Failover and regional redundancy mechanisms are documented in the DR runbook. Customer may request DR evidence under NDA"
Jordan - Acme IT (customer): One additional ask from our side: can you run a quick POC failover with a representative workload (small model, 5k tokens/min) so we can watch end-to-end? 2-week window preferred. Also need pricing delta for Dedicated reserved vs burst for expected QPS.
Ava - Account Exec: We'll propose a 2-week POC: week 1 warmup + baseline metrics, week 2 failover drill and canary. I'll attach pricing options: reserved monthly commit vs on-demand burst.
Ravi - Solutions Eng: POC plan (short): 1) Provision Dedicated pool (small), 2) Run synthetic traffic for 48h baseline, 3) Trigger failover to secondary region with live traffic cutover, 4) Capture metrics (latency, error rate, KV warm time). I can run this with Acme engineering week of Mar 30.
Marta - InfoSec: Before showing internal runbook excerpts, send them an NDA or point them to the public CAIQ mapping + redacted SOC2 artifacts via secure link. We should avoid sending any PII of other customers in logs.
Ava - Account Exec: I'll send the NDA and the secure link. Olive, Marta — can you confirm by EOD Thursday which docs are shareable vs NDA-only?
Olive - Legal: Confirmed — I will mark the SOC2 full report NDA-only. Summary SOC2 attestation can be shared publicly. Runbook excerpts and test logs are NDA-only. Send me the proposed redactions and I'll sign off.
deploy-bot: deploy/infra:dr-test-20260114 completed — artifact: s3://redwood-dr-tests/2026-01-14/failover-log.txt
Ravi - Solutions Eng: Link to artifacts (NDA path): https://files.redwood.internal/secure/dr/2026-01-14 (requires access). I'll prepare the one-pager and attach the redacted logs.
Jordan - Acme IT (customer): Thanks — once we have NDA in place we'll kick off the POC scheduling. Any rough estimate on incremental cost for the POC (Dedicated small pool + test traffic)?
Ava - Account Exec: Estimate: Dedicated small pool reserved trial ~ $4,500 for 2 weeks (incl. reserved baseline + burst buffer). If they want Private deployment pricing, that's a separate quote — likely higher due to infra/onboarding. I'll include both numbers in the follow-up email.
Marta - InfoSec: Also include the DR test findings summary: no data loss observed, single minor rollback action due to config drift (remediated), lessons learned documented. That helps procurement risk review.
Ava - Account Exec: Great. Action items: Ravi — draft one-pager + attach redacted logs to NDA path; Marta — mark what is NDA-only; Olive — confirm contract SLA excerpt; I'll send NDA to Jordan. Target: deliver package by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
Jordan - Acme IT (customer): Sounds good, thanks all. We'll review NDA asap.
Ava - Account Exec: Closing loop — will post the shared links here once available.
